name.Heavenly White Cake: Sou entènèt jwèt Heavenly White Cake

instructions.Sift together the cake flour, baking pow: Separe farin gato a, poud boulanjri, ak sèl twa fwa
instructions.Beat the egg whites in a bowl until foam: Bat blan ze yo nan yon bòl jiskaske mous
instructions.Add 1/2 cup of the sugar and beat until: Ajoute 1/2 tas sik la epi bat jiskaske meringue a ap kenbe nan pik mou.
instructions.Add the remaining 1 cup sugar and beat u: Ajoute rès 1 tas sik la epi bat jiskaske limyè ak an gonfle
instructions.Add the milk and beat until smooth: Ajoute lèt la ak bat jiskaske lis
instructions.Mix in the vanilla extract and almond ex: Melanje ekstrè vaniy la ak ekstrè zanmann
instructions.Mix in the flour mixture to make a batte: Melanje nan melanj farin lan pou fè yon pat
instructions.Spread the batter in a 15 x 10 x 1 inch: Gaye farin lan nan yon chodyè 15 x 10 x 1 pous aliyen ak papye parchemin.
instructions.Bake at 350 degrees F for 30 to 35 minut: Kwit nan 350 degre F pou 30 a 35 minit
instructions.Transfer and let stand for 10 minutes: Transfere epi kite kanpe pou 10 minit
